depicts: The same wide channel banner as its teal sibling, in a red colour scheme: thin dark band on a flat grey canvas with a rock-like Z logo and red glowing fragments.
text_readable: Readable: "THE OFFICIAL CHANNEL OF", "zExileModz". "DESIGNED BY ATLASHD" is small and faint but partly readable.
composition: The banner strip occupies a narrow horizontal band at the vertical centre; large empty flat grey areas above and below; logo in the centre of the band, text to its right.
tone_and_contrast: Very dark red-black band with dim grey and red elements; low contrast inside the band; the surrounding flat grey is slightly lighter than the band.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Scattered particles and bokeh dots; text is soft and dim; the grey frame above and below is baked into the image.
scan_first_read: A dark, mostly empty grey canvas with a thin dark strip showing a red logo; little is readable.
